hero.title: UA–EU: Strategic Partnership
hero.subtitle: in the Pharmaceutical Sector
hero.event_location: Radisson BLU Hotel Lietuva, Vilnius, Lithuania

eventHighlights.title: Conference Expectations
eventHighlights.event_title_1: Building a robust regulatory system in Ukraine through the implementation of the Twinning Project
eventHighlights.event_title_2: Supporting the implementation of the Critical Medicines Act and the creation of strategic partnerships
eventHighlights.event_title_3: Showcasing the potential of Ukrainian pharmaceutical manufacturers and exploring opportunities for their integration into European medicine supply chains
eventHighlights.event_title_4: Exchange of experience and establishing contacts between state and private participants of the pharmaceutical sector

thematic_panels.title: Thematic Panels
thematic_panels.thematic_desc_1: Discussion of EU expansion as a key factor in the implementation of the Pharma Package, European Biotech Act, and Critical Medicines Act
thematic_panels.thematic_title_2: Ukraine's Pharmaceutical Industry as a Security Factor for the EU
thematic_panels.thematic_desc_2: Presentations by Ukrainian pharmaceutical companies showcasing their role in ensuring the stability and resilience of medicine supply, their integration potential into European value chains, and their innovative products
thematic_panels.thematic_desc_3: The impact of political decisions on the integration of the Ukrainian pharmaceutical system into European standards
thematic_panels.thematic_title_4: Business Analytics and Innovation: Prospects for Strategic Partnerships between Europe and Ukraine
thematic_panels.thematic_desc_4: A series of expert presentations on pharmaceutical market trends, analytical tools, innovative solutions, and opportunities for developing partnerships between Ukrainian and European companies
thematic_panels.thematic_desc_5: Exploring human capital potential and investment opportunities in Ukraine

joint_statement.title: We invite you to sign the Joint Statement
joint_statement.desc: We share the values of the European Union and form one voice for the sake of implementing ambitious European integration reforms! Anyone can join the signing of the statement and contribute to strengthening Ukraine's position in the European arena. Your participation is important to us and will demonstrate your willingness to cooperate for the common goal of building an effective and sustainable healthcare system.

join_guide.title: Please send an official letter of intent to sign the Joint Statement signed by the head of your organization (in any form) to the following address:
join_guide.ceremony: A ceremony of signing the Joint Statement will be held during the conference.
